digest.component_or_area: Bridge reconcile gate and pause/resume surface
propositions: Dual-format gate blob preserves gated_mode reconcile-check plus paused/reason/who/paused_at fields for backward compatibility with old readers
Pause operation returns rc 0 with exact anchored BRIDGE_PAUSED JSON marker before lock acquisition or ticket mutation; workflow recognizes only that marker to skip commit-and-push

Pause provenance enforcement uses repository git user.email and first-pause UTC RFC3339; same-reason re-pause is idempotent and metadata-stable; blank/missing-identity/CAS conflicts refuse without overwrite
Resume is observed-OID CAS compare-and-swap that safely clears absent, valid, or corrupt blob state without decoding
Legacy reconcile-check early return, old rebar reconcile --mode vocabulary, and pre-change blob readers remain functional without regression
